en_lead: A viral receptor-binding protein product targeting ranavirus iridovirus (RSIV) in mandarin fish (Siniperca chuatsi) and sea bass. Administered orally in feed for 5–7 consecutive days; clinical observations show markedly reduced mortality and viral clearance.
